margin.statement: H1 EBITDA up 17% YoY to INR58.7 crores; Q2 EBITDA up 8% YoY to INR27.7 crores; PAT lower due to exceptional gain in prior year
margin.quote: Our H1 EBITDA increased by 17% year-on-year to INR58.7 crores, whereas for Q2 FY27, EBITDA increased to INR27.7 crores, reflecting a growth of around 8% Y-o-Y.

margin.statement: Fastener EBITDA margin historically 15-16%; hope to maintain but exceptional inflation may cause marginal pressure this year
margin.quote: On the fasteners business, we've been hovering between 15% and 16% EBITDA. Like I said a little while ago, we hope to maintain that. But this year is an exceptional year.

margin.statement: Near-term margin pressure from input cost inflation; low-cost inventory exhausted in Q1; pass-through with time lag
margin.quote: As discussed on our previous earnings calls, we exhausted most of our earlier low-cost inventory in Q1. At the same time, commodity and non-commodity input costs have increased significantly amid the ongoing West Asia conflict.

order_book.statement: SEM targeting INR150 crores annual revenue for breakeven; expect to outperform in FY28
order_book.quote: Once we reach a revenue of INR150 crores plus, we'll probably achieve breakeven point at that time.

order_book.statement: SEM production lines for onboard chargers and multifunction units commissioned in Q2; revenue ramp from Q3/Q4 as customer SOPs start
order_book.quote: The production lines for onboard chargers and multifunction units scheduled for commissioning in Q2 has been commissioned as planned.

order_book.statement: STML commercial supplies of high-voltage DC contactors and relays commenced in Q2 FY27 as scheduled
order_book.quote: Commercial supplies, which were scheduled to begin in Q2 FY27, have now commenced.

capex.statement: Fastener capex plan raised from INR80 crores to about INR110 crores; INR25 crores already incurred
capex.quote: Against our earlier capex plan of INR80 crores for fasteners business, we have already incurred about INR25 crores and our total fastener capex plans within the range of about INR110 crores now.

capex.statement: SEM capex INR20 crores and STML capex INR10 crores included in consolidated INR150 crores
capex.value: INR20 crores SEM, INR10 crores STML
capex.quote: So our overall capex at a consolidated level will be about INR150 crores. INR20 crores is going to happen at SEM and about INR10-odd crores at STML.

capex.statement: Stand-alone fastener capex ramped up to INR120 crores for FY27; expected to add roughly INR150 crores revenue capacity
capex.quote: Our -- on our stand-alone fasteners business, the initial capex plan was INR80 crores, which has been ramped up to maybe close to more like INR130 crores this year -- sorry, INR120 crores this year.

pricing_cost.statement: Price pass-through negotiations ongoing with OEMs; some agreed, some under negotiation, some retrospective; expect substantial compensation in H2
pricing_cost.quote: We are negotiating with our customers for price increases, not only on account of steel, which is a normal practice running for years, but this year exceptional item is inflation and cost increases.

pricing_cost.statement: Price recovery expected in Q3 and Q4 with retrospective effect
pricing_cost.quote: Correct. And some of those price increases will have a retrospective effect as well.

risk.statement: Inflation, potential interest rate increases, geopolitical uncertainties remain key factors to watch for industry
risk.quote: However, inflation, potential interest rate increases and geopolitical uncertainties remain important factors to watch.

risk.statement: AEM advanced motor PoC delayed; one PoC expected by end-November, second put on hold by customer due to inflationary pressure
risk.quote: One PoC is delayed, but expected to be completed by the end of November. The second PoC has been put on hold by the customer because of the inflationary pressure that they were facing.

other.statement: Industry Q2 FY27 domestic sales grew ~18% YoY to 83.88 lakh units; H2 expected positive momentum from festive demand, new launches, infra spending, fleet replacement
other.quote: The Indian automobile industry recorded its highest ever second quarter sales across major vehicle segments in Q2 FY27. Domestic sales grew approximately 18% year-on-year to 83.88 lakh units.

other.statement: Fastener business has all major OEMs onboarded; focus on increasing share of wallet and new product development
other.quote: We are already working with pretty much all the customers. There are no major customers to be acquired in that fasteners space.

guidance.statement: NIM guidance 3.85-3.95% for Q3 and Q4 FY27
guidance.quote: Hence, we project NIM in the range of 3.85% to 3.95% for Q3 and Q4.

guidance.statement: ROA expected above 1.6% for FY27
guidance.quote: ROA is expected to move above 1.6% plus range.

guidance.statement: Cost-to-income ratio guidance 45-47% for FY27
guidance.quote: Our cost-to-income will largely be in the range of 45% to 47% for FY27.

guidance.statement: Credit growth target 2-3% above industry level
guidance.quote: We are very conscious with improving our credit growth through secured lending while venturing into other avenues to achieve the credit growth of 2%, 3% above the industry.

margin.statement: NIM increased to 3.87% in 2QFY27 from 3.78% in 1QFY27
margin.quote: Thus, our NIM has increased from 3.78% in 1QFY27 to 3.87% in 2QFY27.

margin.statement: Yield on advances improved to 9.85% in 2QFY27 from 9.79% in 1QFY27
margin.quote: Our yield on advances improved to 9.85% in 2QFY27 from 9.79% in 1QFY27.

margin.statement: Cost of deposits remained stagnant at 5.56% in 2QFY27
margin.quote: At the same time, the cost of deposits remained stagnant at 5.56% for 2QFY27 when compared to 1QFY27.

order_book.statement: Advances grew 26% YoY to INR 72,442 crores in 2QFY27
order_book.quote: We had registered 26% advance growth in 2QFY27 year-on-year, and our advance have increased to INR 72,442 crores from INR 57,561 crores in 2QFY26.

order_book.statement: MSME advances increased by INR 2,600 crores to INR 42,862 crores
order_book.quote: Our core strength, MSME, has increased by INR 2,600 crores, that is, from INR 40,262 crores to INR 42,862 crores.

order_book.statement: Secured retail loans grew by INR 1,134 crores to INR 7,802 crores
order_book.quote: And the new segment, secured retail loans, increased by INR 1,134 crores, that is, from INR 6,668 crores to INR 7,802 crores.

capex.statement: Branch network expanded to 1,000+ branches from 800, new branches delivering consistently
capex.quote: We were at 800 branches. Now, as of today, we are at 1,000-plus branches. The newly opened branches have started delivering quite consistently.

pricing_cost.statement: Deposit cost expected to increase by 10 bps next quarter
pricing_cost.quote: We foresee 10 bps increase there, sir.

risk.statement: Contingent provision of INR 50 crores made for unseen economic uncertainties
risk.quote: The bank has made a contingent provision of INR 50 crores during this quarter, specifically designed for unseen economic uncertainties in future.

other.statement: Gross NPA reduced to 1.44% in 2QFY27 from 1.73% in 1QFY27
other.quote: Our Gross NPA percentage has reduced to 1.44% in 2QFY27 from 1.73% in 1QFY27 which is 29 bps reduction.

other.statement: Slippages INR 175 crores vs recoveries INR 317 crores in 2QFY27
other.quote: For Q2 FY27, the total slippages are INR 175 crores, while the total recoveries for Q2 stood at INR 317 crores, consisting of INR 180 crores from live NPA accounts and INR 137 crores from technically written-off accounts, resulting in negative credit cost.

guidance.statement: Capex around INR300 crores for FY27, slightly lower for FY28
guidance.quote: Yes. I mean it should be around the INR300 crores mark. If you look at our spends have reduced from Q1 into Q2, and we expect it to be more closer around the INR300 crores mark by the end of the year.

guidance.statement: Net finance cost expected INR40-45 crores range for H2 FY27
guidance.quote: It will be within a range between that INR40 crores to INR45 crores.

guidance.statement: H2 FY27 expected stronger than H1 for US business
guidance.quote: Overall, we expect a better H2 for the US business.

guidance.statement: Cash conversion cycle expected to improve back to historic levels by next quarter
guidance.quote: We believe that the cash cycle engines should be back in the next quarter itself.

demand.statement: Ex-US demand and order books across key markets remain healthy
demand.quote: demand and order books across our key Ex-US markets remain healthy.

demand.statement: US B2B partner business saw strong order book and meaningful new business wins
demand.quote: Our B2B partner business saw a strong order book, and we secured meaningful new business wins during the quarter, from a partnered product, our recent launches and other key molecules in our portfolio.

margin.statement: Gross margin 56% in Q2 FY27, H1 at 58.3%; confident of sustaining H1 gross margins going forward
margin.quote: Our material costs rose to 44% of revenues in Q2 from 42.2% last year, reflecting the increase in raw material costs that Badree described. This moderated our gross margins to 56% for Q2. Importantly, for the first half, gross margins stood at a healthy 58.3%.

margin.statement: EBITDA margin 17.6% in Q2 FY27, compressed by higher material, freight and supply chain costs
margin.quote: Our EBITDA for the quarter was INR251 crores, our highest ever at a margin of 17.6%. Higher material, freight and supply chain costs linked to the geopolitical situation compressed our margins and tempered the flow-through of a very strong revenue growth, but it did not hold back the growth in our absolute profitability.

margin.statement: Ex-US margins slightly higher than company average EBITDA
margin.quote: It should be slightly higher than the company average in terms of the EBITDA because it depends on the B2B as well as the B2C markets. Overall, I think the gross margins and the EBITDA are good in these markets.

order_book.statement: Ex-US revenue reached INR6,963M in Q2 FY27, up 31% YoY; H1 up 24% YoY to INR12,838M
order_book.quote: Ex -US revenue for Q2 reached ₹6,963 million, an outstanding 31% growth year -on-year. For H1, revenue was ₹12,838 million, up 24% year -on-year.

order_book.statement: US revenue INR6,855M ($73M) in Q2 FY27, up 9% YoY and QoQ; H1 up 7% YoY to INR13,137M
order_book.quote: Revenue for Q2 stood at ₹6,855 million, or $73 million, growing 9% year -on-year and 9% quarter -on-quarter. For H1, US revenue was ₹13,137 million, up 7% year-on-year.

capex.statement: Capex and intangibles INR208 crores deployed in H1 FY27 for differentiated pipeline including nasal spray, transdermal patch, controlled substances
capex.quote: At the same time, we continue to invest in our future, deploying INR208 crores in capex and intangibles to support our growth platforms. Including our nasal spray and transdermal patch programs, these investments are directed at the differentiated pipeline Badree outlined, including our controlled substances opportunity, which will broaden our addressable market and support margin accretive growth

pricing_cost.statement: Material costs rose to 44% of revenue in Q2 from 42.2% last year due to geopolitical situation; alternate sourcing and procurement initiatives underway
pricing_cost.quote: Our material costs rose to 44% of revenues in Q2 from 42.2% last year, reflecting the increase in raw material costs that Badree described.

product_mix.statement: US portfolio shifting to higher-margin differentiated products; 40+ value-accretive products in active pipeline with filings through FY30
product_mix.quote: As I mentioned earlier, our US portfolio is steadily shifting toward higher-margin, differentiated products. We have more than 40 value-accretive products in our active pipeline, with filings and approvals planned in a phased manner and commercialisation through FY30.

product_mix.statement: Controlled substances portfolio: 5 commercialized products (6% of US revenue, $750M market); 10+ pipeline products across nasal sprays, patches, films expanding addressable market to $4.5B
product_mix.quote: Today, our five commercialised CS products, all oral solid tablets, contribute about 6% of our US revenue an d address a market of around $750 million. other.statement: Chestnut Ridge facility has capacity and expertise for US-manufactured controlled substance products including nasal sprays, patches and films
other.quote: Regulations require these products to be manufactured in the US, and our Chestnut Ridge facility already has the capacity and expertise to do exactly that.

other.statement: Industry-leading service levels central to winning/retaining business with largest US customers and partners
other.quote: We continue to deliver industry -leading service levels to all our customers. This is a real competitive advantage, and it is central to winning and retaining business with some of the largest customers and partners in the market.

guidance.statement: Ash & Coal Handling revenue growth target 20-25% YoY for FY27 and FY28
guidance.quote: As we have spoken in the earlier call also, we'll have 20% to 25% of the revenue growth in the years to come.

guidance.statement: Wind energy EBITDA margin 4-5% and PAT margin 2.5-3% for FY27 and H1 FY28
guidance.quote: we have EBITDA margin of 4% to 5%, PAT margin of 2.5% to 3% over there. For in the current financial year and the coming financial year till half year.

guidance.statement: Standalone EBITDA margin 15-18% for FY27
guidance.quote: Our EBITDA margin in the stand-alone basis will be between 15% to 18%, which we have spoken during all all the previous call.

margin.statement: RMC segment expected to contribute to profitability from FY28; FY27 focused on plant setup and team building
margin.quote: RMC segment will start contributing to the overall profitability from the coming financial year and it will contribute a good amount to the total profitability. In the current financial year, it will go towards the setting up of the new plant and establishing the team across the location.

order_book.statement: Large wind energy order in final price negotiation, expected closure in 30-45 days
order_book.quote: We are in the final stage of price negotiation. Project execution and ROW issue or land issue, I mean, won't come to us because we are only the equipment supplier. And we are in the final price negotiations closure stage for the large volume of the order. I mean we should close within next 30 days to 45 days time, and we'll announce the sale with it.

capex.statement: RMC business uses capital-light lease-based model with zero capex for plants
capex.quote: Importantly, we are adopting a capital-light lease-based model that enables us to scale without significant investment in fixed assets. We believe this is the right way to build the business.

capex.statement: Wind energy indigenous manufacturing plant operational in 12-14 months, margin impact after 18-24 months
capex.quote: Manufacturing plant should be operational within 12 to 14 months. And there will be a real impact of that will take an other 6 months after that on the profitability. Certainly, that will be a good impact on the profitability, after 1 year, 1.5 years in the books of account.

risk.statement: Monsoon impacts Q2 ash handling volumes (35,000-40,000 MT in Q2 vs 90,000 target); seasonal revenue fluctuation expected
risk.quote: This Q2 was quite less. It was around 35,000 to 40,000. And volume started going up, though there in some part, there was a tsunami or the rain going on for last 1 week, but volume started going up.

other.statement: Pune RMC plant targeting 4,000-4,500 cubic meters per month
other.quote: We should anticipate volumes of almost about 4,000, 4,500 cubic meters per month from this plant alone.

other.statement: India installed wind capacity reached 59.2 GW as of Sep 2026
other.quote: As a result, the country total installed wind capacity reached 59.2 gigawatts as on September 2026.

guidance.statement: EBITDA per ton guidance maintained at INR9,000-12,000 for foreseeable future
guidance.quote: Our guidance remains INR9,000 to INR12,000 as EBITDA per ton.

guidance.statement: Full-year sales volume target revised to ~260,000 tons
guidance.quote: So, we expect sales of about 260,000 tons now for the year. Budget was about 260,000 tons.

demand.statement: Strong demand driven by auto (2W, SUV, PV) and non-auto; tractors showing slight slowdown
demand.quote: Demand was strong. And pa rtly demand has been strong because of the GST cuts, which happened last year on 2-wheelers as well as the smaller vehicles as well as SUV sales have been good

margin.statement: Kocks Block & reheating furnace raised capacity to 300KTPA, improved yields, cut job work, boosted margin
margin.quote: So, with the combination of Kocks Block and reheating furnace, we have been able to increase our capacity to 300,000 tons. And we can actually increase this capacity even beyond this.

capex.statement: New steel plant cost to exceed INR2,000 crore; forging plant capex lower than budgeted INR475 crore
capex.quote: But suffice it to say at this point in time that the project cost will be higher than the INR2,000 crores that we had envisaged.

capex.statement: Existing plant capex ~INR150 crore per year; brownfield expansion to 360KTPA needs ~INR100-115 crore
capex.quote: It will be about INR150 crores for the existing plant. And for the steel plant, as I said, we are still considering the final figures that will be investing.

pricing_cost.statement: Price increase letters of INR3,500-4,000/ton sent for Q3; Q2 settlements ongoing
pricing_cost.quote: The other companies have sent out letters for price increases, which are ranging between INR3,500 to INR4,000 a ton.

product_mix.statement: Seeding non-auto segments (tool & die, oil & gas, railways, bearings) via ingot casting from Nov 2026
product_mix.quote: So, we are starting with ingot casting, which is the route to make specialized stee ls. This is something that we will start in the end of November, it will

risk.statement: Project implementation risk cited as biggest risk; no new competitor capacity expected for 2-3 years
risk.quote: There are several risks. One, there's a project implementation risk. Two, I think that's the biggest risk that we have.

other.statement: Receivables up due to higher sales in Aug-Sep; debtor days increased 4-5 days
other.quote: In number of days, it has increased by 4 to 5 days only because of some sales to customers who are having a high credit period.

other.statement: Solar expansion of 22.5 MW (20 MW for current plant, 2.5 MW for forging NDT line)
other.quote: And we are now expanding the solar plant by another 22.5 megawatts. 20 -megawatt for this will be for the current plant and 2.5 -megawatt will be for the NDT line.

demand.statement: 5G subscriber base grew 36 million in Q1 to exceed 463 million, driving sustained operator investment
demand.quote: According to the recent TRAI data, India's 5G subscriber base grew by 36 million in the first quarter, exceeding 463 million subscribers.

demand.statement: Industry added ~30,000 5G BTS in Q2, total installed base ~593,000; focus shifting to densification
demand.quote: With the industry adding approximately 30,000 5G BTS s during the second quarter, taking the total installed base to around 593,000.

demand.statement: Total data volume up 30% YoY in Q1; 5G usage up 79% YoY, now 44% of total consumption
demand.quote: In Q1, total data volume increased by 30% year -on-year, supported by an 18% rise in average monthly usage per subscriber. Notably, 5G networks are accelerating this trend, with 5G usage alone growing 79% year-on-year, representing 44% of total data consumption, up from 32% in the prior year.

margin.statement: Reported EBITDA grew 2.5% QoQ to INR46.3bn; EBITDA margin improved 80bps QoQ to 54.4%
margin.quote: Reported EBITDA increased by 2.5% quarter-on-quarter and stands at INR46.3 billion for the quarter. Our EBITDA margin also improved by 80 basis points quarter-on-quarter and stands at 54.4% for the quarter.

margin.statement: Energy margin improved to -3.6% in Q2 from -4.6% in Q1 and -4.8% YoY; diesel consumption down 11% YoY
margin.quote: Our energy margin was negative 3.6% in Q2 compared to negative of 4.6% in Q1 and negative 4.8% in the corresponding quarter of last year, reflecting a significant improvement during the reported quarter. Our structured energy efficiency measures are yielding positive results, and diesel consumption is further reduced by 11% year-on-year.

order_book.statement: Added ~2,900 macro towers and 7,900 co-locations in Q2; tower base ~270,500, co-location base ~440,200
order_book.quote: We added approximately 2,900 macro towers and robust co-locations of 7,900, marking year -on-year growth of 5.6% in towers and 5.9% in co-locations. Our total macro tower and co-location base reached approximately 270,500 and 440,200, respectively.

order_book.statement: Strong order book visibility from major customers driving tower and tenancy growth
order_book.quote: we do have a visibility of a strong order book. And I think we will keep executing based on that order book. So yo u'll continue to see our delivery in the line with what the orders we have

capex.statement: Growth capex increase reflected in CWIP rising ~INR250 cr QoQ due to healthy order book; capex includes towers, tenancies, 5G upgrades, solar
capex.quote: If you follow our balance sheet, there is an increase of around INR250-odd crores on the CWIP value quarter-on-quarter, which is a reflection of what Prachur was alluding on the very healthy order book what we have.

capex.statement: Africa tower deployments commenced in Zambia and Uganda in Q2; Nigeria deployment starting in Q3; early capex per tower within plan
capex.quote: We have successfully deployed towers in Zambia and Uganda in Q2 and also started generating revenue. In line with our phased rollout plan, we are set to begin deployment in Nigeria during the current quarter and our early capex performance per tower remains within the plan, validating our cost model during the initial phases.

pricing_cost.statement: Annual rental escalation covers majority of inflation impact on opex; capex rates revised per MSA where flexibility exists
pricing_cost.quote: I think first is the escalation that we have that takes care of the inflation impact when it comes to opex. As far as capex is concerned, based on our MSA, whichever rates are to be revised on capex, wherever we have that flexibility, that is accordingly adjusted for the customers.

product_mix.statement: IBS deployments gaining market share for two consecutive years; provided solutions for India Mobile Congress and Vizag Airport
product_mix.quote: Supported by a specialized team focused on design and execution, the company has led incremental market share gains in new IBS deployments for two consecutive years and remains focused on expanding its presence in this segment while enhancing the end user connectivity experience.

risk.statement: Africa expansion at early stage; meaningful metrics to be shared in subsequent quarters as portfolio reaches representative scale
risk.quote: As the portfolio reaches to a more representative scale, we intend to share more detail on operational and financial metrics in subsequent quarters.

other.statement: Tenancy ratio improved from 1.62 to 1.63 driven by sharing of existing towers
other.quote: Our industry -leading tenancy ratio has also improved from 1.62 to 1.63, driven by substantial rollout through sharing of our existing towers.

other.statement: Government support for smart meter deployment on telecom towers; ~140,000 sites deployed over 3 years
other.quote: Government support for smart meter deployment on telecom towers has further reinforced telecom infrastructure as a priority consumer category. Over the last three years, we have deployed smart meters on approximately 140,000 sites.

guidance.statement: Revenue growth guidance revised to early 20s percent for FY27 from prior mid-teens to high teens
guidance.quote: I had said mid-teens to high teens. I think now I think early 20s is a good estimate of where we think we'll end the year.

guidance.statement: EBITDA margin long-term guidance anchored at 31-31.5% while funding growth investments
guidance.quote: I would say a long- term guidance of about 31%, 31.5%, where we are funding all these investments for growth is what I would anchor on, right, and not above that.

guidance.statement: Specialty diagnostics target 10-15% of revenue in 3-5 year horizon
guidance.quote: As I said, in a 3 to 5-year horizon, specialty should be at least around 10% to 15% of our revenue, and we'll hold to that.

guidance.statement: API Group ex-Thyrocare profitability target by Q4 FY27 before any corporate action discussion
guidance.quote: I have guided to API Group ex-Thyrocare turning profitable by Q4 FY27. It is only by then that I think even any kind of corporate action would be in the realm of discussion.

demand.statement: Pathology business grew 27% YoY in Q2 FY27; test volumes up 27%, patients up 13%, tests per patient up 12%
demand.quote: Continuing the growth momentum of over 20% achieved in each of the past 2 years, our pathology business grew even faster in Q2 FY27, delivering 27% growth.

order_book.statement: Active franchisee base reached 12,911 with record 1,180 net additions in Q2 FY27
order_book.quote: We added about 1,180 franchises in the quarter, our highest quarterly addition in 3 years, taking the active base of franchise to a record of 12,911.

capex.statement: H1 FY27 capex of INR30 crores for 8 new labs and capacity; similar capex expected in H2
capex.quote: During H1 FY27, a capex of INR30 crores has been invested on account of new lab expansion, 5 in this quarter and 3 in quarter 1 and capacity capex to support 27% volume growth. pricing_cost.statement: Pregnancy kit gross margin comparable to diagnostics business; EBITDA margin normalized comparable but not EPS accretive for 3 quarters due to marketing spend
pricing_cost.quote: From an economic standpoint, I would say gross margin of this business is more or less comparable to our diagnostics business. And the EBITDA margin of this business is also at a normalized level comparable to our pathology business.

product_mix.statement: Pregnancy test kit available in 10,000+ pharmacies via Ascent distribution; listed on PharmEasy and quick commerce platforms
product_mix.quote: Today, we are already present in 10,000-plus pharmacies.

product_mix.statement: Specialty diagnostics launched (allergy, genomics) contributing ~4% of pathology revenue; pregnancy test kit launched at INR60 MRP with Beta hCG confirmation at INR399
product_mix.quote: While the specialty segments currently contribute only around 4% of our pathology revenue, the early traction reflects the benefits of our strategic investments.

risk.statement: NHL impairment of INR9 crores (standalone) and INR45 crores (consolidated) taken; non-recurring, non-cash, no operational impact

risk.quote: Separately, based on the latest valuation and term sheet, we have reassessed NHL's carrying value and taken an impairment of INR9 crores in Thyrocare standalone books and of INR45 crores in the consolidated financials against the goodwill arising from the acquisition of NHL.

other.statement: Operating cash flow of INR133 crores generated in H1 FY27
other.quote: In cash flow, during H1 FY27, we generated INR133 crores from operating activities.

other.statement: Net cash and equivalents of INR211 crores with zero debt as of 30 September 2026
other.quote: Our balance sheet continues to be strong and resilient, with net cash and equivalents of over INR211 crores and zero debt as on 30 September 2026.

guidance.statement: Loan book growth guidance maintained at 18-20% for FY27
guidance.quote: So, I think, you know, the growth guidance which we given was 18% to 20%, I think, we would be always very happy to grow at what we have delivered now. But currently we are maintaining the guidance.

guidance.statement: ROA guidance maintained at 2.4% for FY27 despite Q2 beat
guidance.quote: No, we are maintaining that. See, this time again, as we said, there is some one-offs in the overall interest income. Which has led to higher ROA. The normalized ROA is 2.4, which is in line with Q1.

demand.statement: No demand impact seen from 25 bps repo hike; momentum continues
demand.quote: So honestly, I think, you know, this 25 bps repo increase, we have not seen any change in terms of momentum in the market because market has easily absorbed that, which reflect in overall industry.

margin.statement: Spread improved 31 bps QoQ to 2.43%; NIM improved 17 bps QoQ to 3.67%
margin.quote: Coming to margins, our spread increased by 31 bps sequentially to 2.43%. Excluding one-off spread would be 12 bps higher, that is 2.24%. NIM improved by 17 bps sequentially to 3.67%.

margin.statement: Expect spread and NIM to improve further from current levels
margin.quote: With higher incremental yield vs book yield and rising interest rate scenario, we feel that spread and NIM should further improve from hereon.

order_book.statement: Overall disbursements grew 60% YoY to INR 9,609 crores in Q2 FY27

order_book.statement: Retail disbursements reached all-time high of INR 9,250 crores, up 54% YoY
order_book.quote: Retail disbursements reached an all-time high of INR 9,250 crores, registering a growth of 54% YoY.

order_book.statement: Loan book grew 19% YoY to INR 95,079 crores as of Sep 30, 2026
order_book.quote: This translated to an overall loan book of INR 95,079 crores as on 30th September '26, representing growth of 19% YoY.

pricing_cost.statement: Cost of borrowing improved 5 bps QoQ to 7.31%; incremental cost improved 15 bps to 7.26%

guidance.statement: Planning to close FY27 at ₹580-600 Cr top line and double PAT margin
guidance.quote: And, planning to close the financial year at, around ₹580 Cr to ₹600 Cr as a top line, and, double the PAT margin, EBITDA say ₹12.5 Cr for H1 result.

demand.statement: India air cargo target 10 million tons by 2030, nearly 2.7x current volume
demand.quote: India's Ministry of Civilization has set a policy target of 10 million tons of air cargo by annually by 2030 . So it's almost 2.7 times its current volume.

demand.statement: E-commerce and courier growing multi-fold internationally; retail courier launched this month
demand.quote: E-commerce and Courier is one of the products that is growing rapidly. The growth that you have seen in e-commerce and Courier in the last 10 years domestically, that same growth is happening internationally now.

margin.statement: Margins will increase quarter on quarter as infrastructure can handle double current business
margin.quote: So, margin, bottom line, you will see increasing quarter on quarter and year on year, definitely.

order_book.statement: H1 FY27 shipments grew 56% to 674 and tonnage grew 32.84% to 744 tons
order_book.quote: You can see the growth in the number of shipments also from 430 shipments to 674 shipments the H1. And, tonnage also is increased. From 545 tons to 744 tons.

capex.statement: Building technology platform like MakeMyTrip for cargo; expected ready by end of year
capex.quote: We're also look… looking at… our technology platform, wherein we are trying to do something like MakeMyTrip, but for cargo and courier. So, you know the platform is currently being built, but within a few months from now, I think it should be ready, hopefully by the end of the year.

pricing_cost.statement: Maintain margins when freight rates rise; 90% of time margins held regardless of rate doubling/tripling
pricing_cost.quote: Whatever our margins are, even if the Freight is double, tripled, we'll still maintain our margins. That's what we try and do as much as possible. And I can assure you, 90% of the time we do that.

product_mix.statement: Ocean freight is 70-80% of global trade; company plans to grow ocean freight for scale
product_mix.quote: Currently, ocean freight is 70-80% of all global trade volumes, so that is where you know, we would like, like I said earlier, also, we would like to have some market share, or some big… so if we want to grow the company to a great extent, we are going to look at Ocean Freight.

risk.statement: Freight rates volatile due to geopolitical factors (war, airspace restrictions) and fuel prices
risk.quote: Like, there are some places where ocean freight, where the prices increase because of the war and everything or maybe if you can't fly over Pakistan, then those freights are increasing.

other.statement: Current infrastructure can handle double the business volume
other.quote: Our costs remain the same, our infrastructure… current infrastructure can even do double the business that we are currently doing.

other.statement: Top 3 with major airlines (Air India, Emirates, Qatar, Lufthansa); serve large supermarkets Lulu, Nesto via charters
other.quote: We feature amongst the top 10 in India, and we are among the number one, in the top 3 in most airlines out of India, like Air India, Emirates, Qatar, Lufthansa, and most airlines we feature among the top 3.

guidance.statement: Capex guidance for FY27 revised to INR400-450 crores from earlier INR450 crores; FY28 capex allocated at INR700 crores
guidance.quote: So, we still maintain that we will maybe instead of INR450, we might spend INR400 odd crores for the coming year. And then in '28 is when we expect the construction to significantly pick up. So, then we have allocated a larger amount. Currently, it's been allocated as INR700 crores for FY28.

guidance.statement: Management expects RevPAR growth in mid-teens range for H2 FY27 and maintains mid-teens revenue and EBITDA growth guidance for FY27
guidance.quote: the second half of the year to be better. I can't get into the specific number, but our intention is that it will grow in mid-teens range

demand.statement: Q3 FY27 expected to be strong supported by festive demand, wedding season, and healthy MICE calendar; corporate travel normalizing and international arrivals recovering in H2 FY27
demand.quote: October trends and forward inquiries indicate a strong Q3 supported by festive demand, the start of the wedding season, and healthy MICE calendar across our markets. Industry outlooks also point to stronger growth in the second half of FY27 as corporate travel normalizes and international arrivals gradually recover.

order_book.statement: Construction for two Hyatt Regency hotels in Bangalore SPVs to start within next 2-3 quarters; 350-key and 250-key hotels in mixed-use developments
order_book.quote: We are looking to start construction for these two hotels within the next two to three quarters.

capex.statement: INR484 crores deployed till September 2026 out of INR3,600 crores planned capex; INR84 crores spent in H1 FY27; further INR400-450 crores expected in H2 FY27 including acquisition capital
capex.value: INR484 crores deployed to date, INR84 crores in H1 FY27, INR400-450 crores in H2 FY27
capex.quote: Of the approximately INR3,600 crores capex planned for our upcoming projects, INR484 crores has been deployed to date, of which INR84 crores was incurred during H1 FY27. We expect to deploy a further INR400 to INR450 crores in H2 FY27, including capital earmarked for unidentified acquisition.

product_mix.statement: Luxury and upper upscale mix to increase from 14% today to 31% by FY29 and 38% by FY31 with 1,700 keys under development across Grand Hyatt, InterContinental, JW Marriott, Ritz-Carlton brands
product_mix.quote: This will lift our luxury and upper upscale mix from 14% today to 31% by FY29 and 38% by FY31.

other.statement: Renewable energy accounts for 67% of total energy needs across portfolio
other.quote: On the sustainability front, renewable energy now accounts for 67% of our total energy needs across the portfolio.

other.statement: Actively evaluating acquisition opportunities in markets where BHVL doesn't operate (prime business or strong leisure markets); top priority for next 2-3 quarters; may roll into additional quarter due to due diligence
other.quote: We are actively looking at multiple opportunities. We've looked at quite a few. I think the hotel industry since it's also doing well, it's hard to get something with the right value and an asset that will give us the right kind of returns. We are still actively looking. Yet to finalize on this unidentified opportunity, but hopefully we can do that. I mean, this is also top priority for us maybe i

guidance.statement: Cement volume growth guided at high-teens YoY for FY27
guidance.quote: No, we continue to maintain it will be high-teens growth over last year.

guidance.statement: GGBS volume growth guided at high-single digits for FY27
guidance.quote: Yes. See, as we had guided last time, high-single digits is the forecast that we've given for the year, and we continue to hold ourselves.

guidance.statement: Net debt to EBITDA target below 3x in coming years, around 3x for another year
guidance.quote: But at the same time, we have a mandate to keep the net debt to EBITDA below 3. We will continue to be around 3 for maybe a year or so more. And definitely, it is going to be below 3 in the coming years.

demand.statement: October demand trends positive across all regions and products despite drought concerns
demand.quote: It's been fairly positive, in fact, across GGBS and cement all across.

margin.statement: North region achieved EBITDA breakeven in Q2 FY27, targeting INR650-700 crore EBITDA in Q4 FY27
margin.quote: No, it should be hitting about probably INR650 to INR700 in Q4.

margin.statement: Consolidated operating EBITDA per ton at INR708 in Q2 FY27, ex-North at INR821 per ton
margin.quote: Consolidated operating EBITDA per ton was INR708 for the quarter.

order_book.statement: GGBS volumes grew 7% YoY in Q2 FY27
order_book.quote: GGBS volumes grew by 7% Y-o-Y, as I already mentioned.

order_book.statement: RMC revenue was INR170 crore in Q2 FY27, full year guidance not provided as units still ramping up
order_book.quote: For quarter 2, it was around INR170 crores was the RMC revenues.

pricing_cost.statement: Cement prices increased in September-October: non-trade up INR15-30/bag across regions, trade up INR10-15/bag in East only
pricing_cost.quote: In the South, non-trade, as we speak for October, we're seeing a INR15 to INR20 per bag increase. In the East, we're seeing INR25 to INR30 a bag increase, and INR10 in West and around INR20 per bag in the North.

pricing_cost.statement: North plant cost reduction of INR550-600 per ton expected from WHRS, AFR and OLBC commissioning
pricing_cost.quote: we are expecting our cost to co me down by anywhere in the range of INR550 to INR600 a ton with all this

product_mix.statement: Trade mix stable at 52%, clinker-to-cement factor increased to 58% due to North ramp-up and higher OPC sales
product_mix.quote: Our clinker-to-cement factor increased to 58% with the ramp-up of North operations, especially as we currently are selling a higher quantity of OPC to maximize our kiln usage.

risk.statement: Fuel cost pressure from high pet coke prices, FX losses on unhedged foreign debt, repo rate reset impact on MCLR
risk.quote: As all of you are aware, pet coke prices are at very high levels, and this will create more cost pressure in the coming quarter.

other.statement: Nagaur plant utilization reached 75% in Q2 FY27, expected to improve further in H2
other.quote: Utilization at this plant has increased to 75% during the quarter.

other.statement: Additional 1 MTPA grinding capacity commissioned at Nagaur in October 2026
other.quote: Early this month, we also commissioned the additional 1 MTPA grinding capacity at Nagaur and the overland belt conveyor for transporting limestone from the crusher to our plant.

guidance.statement: Management expects revenue and margins to improve in H2 as project milestones move into execution
guidance.quote: We know and expect the revenue and margins to improve in H2 as the project milestones move into execution.

guidance.statement: PEB and civil works in incubation; clarity expected after one year; may contribute in H2 FY27 or H1 FY28 depending on geopolitics
guidance.quote: This is in process right now, under consideration, depending on the geopolitical situation that can come in H2 FY27 or in H1 FY28.

guidance.statement: Management remains confident of adjusted PAT margin of 8% to 9% at end of FY27 and targets 25% to 30% year-on-year growth
guidance.quote: Number four, we remain confident of an adjusted PAT margin of 8% to 9% at the end of FY27.

demand.statement: Saudi Arabia plans over $15 billion pharma manufacturing investment (Vision 2030); Africa plans over $60 billion medicine production investment until 2040
demand.quote: Two pipelines stand out, which is Saudi Arabia, which plans over $15 billion of pharmaceutical manufacturing investment, which is the Vision 2030, and Africa, which plans over $60 billion of total medicine production investment until 2040.

margin.statement: Management targets 2-3% margin improvement from each of three strategies (localization, alternative sourcing, Green Shield) over next 2-3 years
margin.quote: So the margins that we are looking at is 2 %, 3% each strategy to add on to our ending paths through the next 2 to 3 years.

margin.statement: Q2 EBITDA more than doubled QoQ to INR 15.57 crore with margin expanding 647 bps to 16%; adjusted PAT margin improved 354 bps to 9.2%
margin.quote: Moving to EBITDA, we reported INR 155.7 million in quarter 2 compared to INR 74.1 million in quarter 1 representing a growth of 110% quarter on quarter. Our EBITDA margin expanded by 647 basis points from 9.5% to 16%.

order_book.statement: Order book stands at INR 900 crore, about 2.2 times last year's revenue, with additional INR 800-850 crore pipeline over next year
order_book.value: INR 900 crore order book; INR 800-850 crore pipeline
order_book.quote: On the visibility, our order book stands at INR 900 crores and that's about 2.2 times last year's revenue. On top of the INR 900 crores, we're working on another INR 800 crores to INR 850 crores of added revenue over the next one year.

order_book.statement: Of INR 900 crore order book, ~INR 700 crore commercially cleared and on floor for detail engineering; added orders in last 6 months maintaining book while executing
order_book.quote: So right now, all out of INR 900 crore, approximately INR 700 crore are commercially cleared and on the floor for detail engineering and having the client requirement to plan the execution and all.

capex.statement: Land purchase at Khalapur for INR 18.6 crore is in process; purpose will be clarified by H2 results
capex.quote: I hope you will get a clear visibility by H2 result. That is in process right now.

pricing_cost.statement: Alternative sourcing strategy expected to increase margin opportunities by 2% to 3%
pricing_cost.quote: Number two, alternative sourcing, which is smarter and potentially increasing our margin opportunities by 2 % to 3%.

product_mix.statement: Expanding into cell and gene therapy, high containment, data centres, veterinary and medical devices; data centre scope ~30% of project value
product_mix.quote: I would say 30%. That is the scope of work that Fabtech can execute because like in data centres, the data management systems, the AI integration securities, civil is not executed by Fabtech.

risk.statement: Geopolitical uncertainty in West Asia caused freight volatility, raw material price increases, and added security costs; managed without pipeline cancellation
risk.quote: We dealt with geopolitical uncertainty and freight volatility across the GCC market. But that being said, we are proud that our UAE team kept every site running and every customer commitment on track.

other.statement: Operating cash flow target to turn positive by March 2027; H1 outflow due to INR 38 crore vendor advances for H2 execution
other.quote: So there's almost INR 38 crores is towards -- the increase is towards vendor advances. That answers the current assets increase. With respect to when it will turn positive, that's a more forward looking statement but you can see as in March 26, we were positive operating cash flow so our target is to again go to a positive operating cash flow by March.

other.statement: Hot pipeline at INR 3,600-4,000 crore with INR 800-850 crore conversion expected in next 12 months
other.value: INR 3,600-4,000 crore hot pipeline; INR 800-850 crore conversion
other.quote: The hot pipeline I would say is between INR 3,600 crores to INR 4,000 crores and the conversion cycle that we are seeing in the next 12 months is close to INR 800 crores to INR 850 crores that will add on to our order pipeline.

guidance.statement: Management commits to crossing INR100 crores revenue in FY27 and expects similar growth trajectory to continue in FY28
guidance.quote: For now, we commit that we will surely cross INR100 crores. And let's see, if things move smoothly, then maybe more also.

guidance.statement: Management confident of maintaining similar growth pattern in FY28 as seen in previous years
guidance.quote: The graph will remain constant. It will not decline. It will remain constant. The volume will increase; the line will go straight up.

demand.statement: European partners shifting more work to India due to energy crisis and Chinese competition, creating tailwinds for order inflows
demand.quote: Our European partners are now more inclined to giving more work in India and working with us. So, we are already working with two or three similar projects which normally were executed by our European partners.

demand.statement: Nuclear sector opportunity expanding with 3-4 additional projects beyond executed INR10.62 crore order, some larger in value
demand.quote: We are working on four, five projects additionally, which are not similar to this what we have executed. And some of them are even bigger than this.

margin.statement: H1 FY27 EBITDA margin at 23% driven by in-house manufacturing of components previously outsourced
margin.quote: As you know in our object, we planned to purchase some equipment which will save a lot of money, time, and transportation for us, because we will be making -- we are making these components required for machine manufacturing in-house now.

margin.statement: Management confirms 23% EBITDA margin is sustainable and expects similar or slightly better margins in H2 FY27
margin.quote: Basically, you must have seen the figures from last half and this half, the EBITDA margins have definitely improved, and these are quite sustainable margins. And in H2 also, we will maintain these margins, maybe slightly better, but not less, for sure.

order_book.statement: INR65-70 crores of current order book to be executed before end of FY27
order_book.quote: Out of these INR77 crores, we will be executing around INR65 crores to INR70 crores before end of this fiscal year.

order_book.statement: Management expects good order book build-up by March 31st with many projects in pipeline and finalization stage
order_book.quote: By the time we are finishing this year, we will have a good order book build-up by 31st of March, for sure, because a lot of projects are in pipeline, a lot of projects are in finalization.

order_book.statement: Order book stands at INR77.42 crores with 80-90% expected to be executed by end of FY27
order_book.quote: Our order book stood at INR77.42 crores as of the latest reporting period.

capex.statement: Capex for FY27 estimated at INR15-16 crores split 60% plant & machinery and 40% factory building improvements
capex.quote: Total capex just a moment. I have to see the figures. I think somewhere around INR15 crores, INR16 crores.

capex.statement: CWIP of INR15 crores includes factory building improvements (40%) and plant & machinery (60%) for future margin expansion
capex.quote: So, and balance will be is related to the plant and machinery. So, what Mr. Longani has mentioned meaning we are doing some synergy in terms of having going for a good profit in future years.

pricing_cost.statement: European partners facing higher costs due to energy crisis (power, gas, petrol) making Indian manufacturing more competitive for import substitution
pricing_cost.quote: Since European costs are very high, and Europe is facing their own challenges, and they have also increased their cost because of the power issue, and gas charges, and petrol, everything is expensive in Europe.

product_mix.statement: Revenue mix expected to remain 50% steel and 50% non-steel (NDT and nuclear) for FY27
product_mix.quote: Steel will more or less remain 50%.

product_mix.statement: Developing two import-substitute products (one steel, one nuclear) launching in 3-3.5 months as game changers with better price-performance than European alternatives
product_mix.quote: We are developing two more products currently, which will fulfill Indian market phase in Phase 1, and in Phase 2 outside India also. So, these products will soon launch in next another 3 months maybe, and they these products, once developed, they are also a game changer.

risk.statement: Nuclear project timelines involve 2 quarters for materialization due to government scrutiny, agreements and commercial negotiations
risk.quote: Yes, it takes about 2 quarters to materialize because being government organization, lot of scrutinies, agreements, everything is there. So, when we fulfill everything, then the things move into the commercial zone.

other.statement: H1 FY27 revenue grew 48.34% YoY to INR42.2 crores, EBITDA grew 47.62% to INR9.95 crores, PAT grew 45.91% to INR6.53 crores
other.quote: We have delivered strong year-on-year growth, with revenue from operations increasing by 48.34% to INR42.2 crores. EBITDA grew by 47.62% to INR9.95 crores, while profit after tax increased by 45.91% to INR6.53 crores.

other.statement: Government focus on defense indigenization and nuclear capacity expansion (8.8 GW to 100 GW by 2047) creates long-term structural demand
other.quote: The nuclear power generation currently is at only 8.8 GW. By 2047, government is aiming to make it 100 GW. So, you can imagine the kind of potential we are looking at.
